brokerage.title: Brokerage
brokerage.subtitle: Your brokerage's identity, disclosures and members.

none.title: You haven't declared a brokerage
none.body: You'll declare your brokerage when you complete your profile. Until then you can still draft and prepare listings on your own.

pending.title: Waiting for {brokerage} to approve you
pending.body: A broker admin of {brokerage} needs to approve your membership. Until then, nothing about the brokerage is shared with you, and your listings stay private to you.

ended.body: You no longer have access to this brokerage. You can still prepare listings on your own, and you can declare a brokerage again from your profile.

banner.title: Your membership at {brokerage} is pending approval
banner.body: You can draft listings, run photo analysis, and generate and check content now. Approving marketing and submitting to the MLS unlock once a broker admin approves you, because both carry the brokerage's name and license.

settings.title: Brokerage settings
settings.readOnlyNote: Only a broker admin can change these settings.
settings.name: Brokerage name
settings.requiredDisclaimersHint: One per line. These appear on marketing that names the brokerage.
settings.targetMlsIdHint: For example CRMLS. Leave empty if you don't submit to an MLS.
settings.budgetHint: AI work for a listing stops at this limit, and the agent can continue by hand.

members.title: Members
members.pendingEmpty: No one is waiting for approval.

index.title: Listings

wizard.title: New listing
wizard.subtitle: Enter the basics, add photos, and come back any time — everything saves as you go.
wizard.archived: This listing is archived. It's kept with its history but can no longer be changed.

basics.title: Basic details
basics.agentNotesHint: Private to you. Never copied into public remarks.

save.failed: Couldn't save your last change. It's still here, and saving resumes when you edit again.
save.invalid: Fix the highlighted field and it will save.
save.conflictBody: Another tab or device saved a newer version. Load it to continue; edits made here since then will be replaced.

required.title: Required before publishing
required.body: No public-record source is connected, so enter these yourself. They are never filled in by AI.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Add 1 to 100 photos. Originals are kept exactly as uploaded; nothing is generated or retouched.
photos.formats: JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, up to 50 MB each.
photos.overLimit: You chose {chosen} photos, but this listing has room for {room} more. Nothing was uploaded; choose fewer.
photos.full: This listing has 100 photos, the most allowed.

rejected.too_large: {file} was not accepted: it is larger than 50 MB.
rejected.unsupported_format: {file} was not accepted: it isn't a JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP photo.
rejected.too_many_pixels: {file} was not accepted: its dimensions are too large to process.
rejected.unreadable: {file} was not accepted: it looks damaged or only partly saved.
rejected.duplicate: {file} was not added: it is identical to a photo already on this listing.
rejected.storage_failed: {file} couldn't be stored just now. Add it again.
rejected.unknown: {file} couldn't be uploaded. Add it again.

progress.title: Before you publish
progress.aiNote: Photo analysis and content drafting come next. Every AI result stays a draft until you approve it.
